nodes.title: SG-8.3.2 context.md names the real stack and module paths
nodes.body:
Context: context.md is unchanged since the initial commit and still says 'hello Worldseed', 'Frameworks: UNKNOWN' and 'Executable / server / CLI `main` | UNKNOWN', so the two failing tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts fail. Desired behavior: the file names the real stack and lists the real module paths. Expected result: missingTerms, missingPaths and staleTextHits all return [] and contextModulePaths returns the four required paths. Why: SG-8.3 needs accurate docs. This overlaps SG-8.3.1, so the change is made once.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns [] and the text also names Go for backend/
- Given the repo-root context.md, when staleTextHits(text) runs, then it returns [] and the text has no 'Frameworks: UNKNOWN'
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths(text) runs, then it contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ and missingPaths returns []


## Scope
- In scope: Repo-root context.md content
- In scope: Doc comments of docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts contracts
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: Gameplay changes
- Out of scope: GDD.md content
- Out of scope: Changing or deleting tests
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- Preserve: STACK_TERMS, STALE_TEXT and helper behaviour
- Preserve: Existing contextDoc tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- Both previously failing contextDoc tests pass
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists the real game and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: the module table lists README.md and .gitignore only. Desired behavior: the table has rows for the four real module paths, all existing on disk (game/src, game/frontend/src, game/docs/GDD.md, backend all exist). Expected result: contextModulePaths returns all four and missingPaths returns []. Why: the index must point at real code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when contextModulePaths runs, then the result contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/
- Given those paths, when missingPaths runs against the repo root with existsSync, then it returns []


## Scope

- Preserve: contextModulePaths regex behaviour

- backend/ is listed but not changed
